letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this wild, wonderful life with you. Your laughter is my favorite soundtrack, and your smile lights up my heart like the desert stars. I’m still amazed that our story, which began on a crisp February day, keeps getting sweeter. Thank you for being my cutie, my confidante, my forever adventure partner. I love you more than words can capture, today and always.
poem:
Across the dunes or by the river’s song,  
Your love makes every moment belong.  
In every season, near or far,  
You’re my forever, my shining star.
